about_the_game:
📘 Five Hearts Under One Roof: Season 2 Digital Photobook

Five Hearts Under One Roof: Season 2 Digital Photobook

The cast of Five Hearts Under One Roof: Season 2 returns with another story to tell.

From memorable in-game moments to exclusive behind-the-scenes photos and interviews —

this photobook captures every precious moment of the women you’ve come to love.

Within its 60 beautifully designed pages, you’ll find:

Personal letters from the cast, Never-before-seen photos,

Emotional scenes that complete the endings of Season 2.

Step once more into the world of Five Hearts Under One Roof and experience it all over again.

💫 CONTENTS

1. Cast & Characters

Photos, short letters, and mini interviews from the lead actresses of Season 2.

Feel their unique charms and personalities once more.

2. Memorable Moments

Revisit the most emotional and heart-warming scenes from the game, captured in stunning in-game moments.

3. Ending Gallery

A visual collection of the multiple endings shaped by your choices throughout the story.

4. Behind the Scenes

Unreleased photos and candid shots of the cast, their laughter, energy, and natural moments on set.

5. Epilogue & Credits

Messages from the production team and the story behind how Five Hearts Under One Roof: Season 2 came to life.
